title: 36 Hours in Berlin
abstract: In the evolving German capital, where neighborhoods are being transformed, there are fresh spots to see art, sip cocktails and savor a bite.

title: 36 Hours in Buenos Aires
abstract: Dine in a private supper club, tour a renowned opera house and soak up some nature by the Río de la Plata during a weekend in Argentina’s capital.

title: 36 Hours in Reykjavik
abstract: See the city’s award-winning new architectural landmark, stay up (very) late on a pub crawl, find peace on a nearby island and far more during a weekend in Iceland’s capital.

title: 36 Hours in Hampstead, London
abstract: Pack a picnic for the Heath, stroll through chapters of history and even take a bracing dip during a weekend in London’s worst-kept, high-altitude secret.
